metadata.title: Bullish Earnings Shine as It Moves Beyond Crypto Trading. A Deal and Buybacks Are in the Works.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Bullish Earnings Shine as It Moves Beyond Crypto Trading. A Deal and Buybacks Are in the Works.
Bullish delivered a third-quarter earnings beat Wednesday, a good sign for its push to bridge traditional capital markets and blockchain infrastructure even while the cryptocurrency sector is in a rut.
